# Crime Network Starter Brief

A practical reader brief for organized crime, cartel logistics, court records, sanctions, laundering routes, and crime-state overlap pages.

## Branded PDF Mini Book

## Boundary

Lead magnets are public orientation assets with a seven-day intelligence window. They do not increase evidence strength or replace trust/privacy pages.

## Promise

Get the crime-network route while keeping association, indictment, sanction, conviction, and speculation boundaries clear.

## Reader Outcome

The reader knows how to follow crime-network records without turning association or investigation into automatic guilt.
